_comment: Format edited TS/JS files with prettier. The bootstrap merges this into the project's .claude/settings.json under 'hooks'. Reads the hook's stdin JSON (tool_input.file_path) — the proven interface, not a $CLAUDE_FILE_PATH env var.

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read f; if [ -n "$f" ]; then case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && npx prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac; fi; }
